Print method for validation-report tibbles

Source: R/tibble-classes.R
print.assertr_tibble.Rd

Replaces the standard tibble header (# A tibble: N x M) with a black divider line, hides the column-type chip row (<chr> <int> ...), and adds an italic legend explaining the E / W / W* / N severity codes used by assert_metadata(). Implemented with cli only (no pillar dependency).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'assertr_tibble'
print(x, n = NULL, width = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

An assertr_tibble.

n, width

Forwarded to the underlying tibble print method.

...

Forwarded.
